summary.name: Notion AI
summary.one_liner: Notion AI is the built-in AI assistant inside the Notion workspace, offering agents, enterprise search, meeting notes, and writing help over pages, docs, tasks, and databases.
use_cases: Drafting and improving writing inside Notion pages
Searching across Notion, Slack, and Google Drive
Automating recurring team tasks with agents
Generating research reports on a topic
Auto-filling database properties and writing formulas
summary.what_it_does: Notion AI works directly inside Notion pages, docs, tasks, and databases, using workspace context and connected apps when enabled. Notion Agent can take on multi-step tasks such as creating and editing pages and databases. Custom Agents run on a trigger or schedule to automate recurring team work, such as answering questions on Slack or routing tasks. Enterprise Search and AI Meeting Notes cover finding information across connected apps and transcribing and summarizing meetings. The page states Notion AI does not use customer data to train models unless the user opts in, and credits are allocated monthly per member on Business and Enterprise plans.
notable: Custom Agents that run on triggers or schedules for whole teams
Enterprise Search across Slack, Google Drive, and GitHub
Monthly Standard (1,500) and Select (500) credit allowances per member on Business and Enterprise plans
Zero-retention LLM APIs for HIPAA compliance on Enterprise
caveats: AI features are on Business and Enterprise plans with credit limits; access may be temporarily reduced based on usage
Several capabilities such as Enterprise Search and Premium connections are labeled Beta or tied to higher plans
Notion AI is shown with a trial only on the free tier; full access requires paid plans
